subject: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com>; Azure Publisher Support <azurepublishersupport@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint

Hi Sofia / Azure team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the marketplace listing. As we discussed, the next 5 days are a focused sprint to get Acme's publisher account verified, the offer registered in the portal, and co-sell readiness documented. To keep things tight, proposed plan below: 

1) Today (May 22): Confirm publisher admin delegation + sign mandate (we've attached the mandate draft).
2) May 23: Provide service principal evidence and ARM template snippets for the offer (we'll run a compatibility smoke test).
3) May 24: Validate billing Sku mapping and co-sell metadata; Redwood to provide sample manifest.
4) May 25: Final sign-off and publish window scheduling with Microsoft contact.

Please confirm: who will accept the publisher delegation in Acme? Also attaching a short roles matrix and a guide for creating the service principal and role assignment we need.

Attachments: acme-mrp-service-principal-guide.pdf, publisher-roles-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to quick turnaround.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Azure Publisher Support <azurepublishersupport@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint

Marcus —

Thanks, that timeline works. I'll be the primary for accepting delegation; I'll also loop in our cloud infra lead if needed. A couple quick questions: 

- For the service principal evidence, do you need a screenshot of the role assignment in the portal or the JSON output from az ad sp show?
- On the manifest side, can you confirm which fields trigger co-sell eligibility? We want to avoid back-and-forth.

I'll sign the mandate and upload to the DocSend link you sent earlier by EOD.

Regards,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Analytics
sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint

Great — thanks, Sofia. Short answers: 

- Service principal: both are fine but prefer the az CLI JSON (az ad sp show) plus a portal screenshot for quick verification. The JSON is the canonical evidence we store.
- Co-sell triggers: in short, you need the co-sell metadata in the offer manifest (coSellContact + coSellEligible true), evidence of customer references (if required by tier), and matching billable SKUs. Karthik will paste the minimal manifest snippet below.

Karthik: can you drop the minimal manifest snippet and the exact role needed for the SP?

I'll track the DocSend upload — ping when you've uploaded the signed mandate.

— Marcus
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint

Hi all —

Minimal items we need from Acme for the tech validation step: 

- Service principal JSON (az ad sp show --id <appId>) and a screenshot of the role assignment in the subscription scope. Role: Contributor on the Offer subscription is sufficient.
- ARM template snippet for the offer resource (we only need the resources array sample that creates the managed app registration).
- Storage SAS token proof (if you host assets via blob) — read-only SAS with expiry > 7 days.
- Signed manifest draft (we'll provide a template).

Manifest minimal snippet (example):
{
  "offerId": "acme-analytics/predictor",
  "planId": "standard",
  "coSell": {
    "coSellEligible": true,
    "coSellContact": {
      "name": "Sofia Alvarez",
      "email": "sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com"
    }
  }
}

Notes: we don't need the full ARM resource to run the portal validation; the snippet is only used for manifest linting. If you can drop the JSON and a small ARM snippet to DocSend, we'll lint and return results within 4 hours.

- Karthik

On a separate note: Naomi, I'll need the co-sell checklist filled for the partner motion so Marissa can start the sales enablement pack.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher account delegation, technical evidence & co-sell sprint

All —

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Sofia — I can confirm we've received the following: 

- Signed mandate (signed-mandate.docx) via DocSend link
- Service principal JSON and portal screenshot (az output captured)
- ARM snippet and blob SAS token (read-only, expiry +10 days)
- Completed manifest draft with coSell metadata included

Next steps (confirmed):
- Redwood to run manifest lint + portal smoke test tomorrow morning (May 26) and return a single remediation list if any issues.
- Marissa will draft the co-sell enablement one-pager and the sample pitch template by May 28.
- Marcus will schedule the final publish window with Azure contact (cc: azurepublishersupport).

Sofia: appreciate the quick action. If you want a short sync (15 min) to confirm role assignment details before the lint, Marcus — happy to host.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com

Cheers,
Marcus
